name: Floating Stats CTA
description: Dark rounded CTA section: a left photo collage with a floating white stat card, an overlapping portrait, and a glass 'experience' card, beside a right column with an outline badge, oversized pitch heading, intro, a big review counter with divider, and a primary call-to-action button.
interactions: right-column items fade up once the section reaches 20% viewport (IntersectionObserver), 600ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), 90ms per-item stagger
collage cards pop in (opacity + translateY + scale) with per-element delays 0/160/240/320ms via a --d custom property
card-stat, card-exp and portrait lift -4px on hover, 200ms
CTA hover/active follow design-system button states, 120ms
prefers-reduced-motion: reveals and pops render in final state, hovers off
